subject: Mutual Action Plan: NovaHealth / Redwood Inference - MAP draft & timeline update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@novahealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: NovaHealth / Redwood Inference - MAP draft & timeline update

Hi Jordan & Alyssa,

Thanks again for the call today — great discussion and clear priorities. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing milestones, owners, dependencies, and our proposed target close. Highlights:  

- Target close: 2026-12-15 (TBD based on procurement window)
- Key milestones: PO submission, Security review, Pilot setup, Executive sign-off
- Responsibilities: NovaHealth procurement/IT/clinical ops vs Redwood solution engineering/sales/CS
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, network/VPC testing window, pilot data readiness

Please review the attached NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx and confirm whether the milestone owners and dates look right. If procurement needs a longer review, we can reforecast — just flag which milestone drives the change.

Next steps from us:
1) I'll share an updated MAP with explicit dates and a one-page exec summary (tomorrow)
2) Rishi will follow up with SOC2 and architecture docs for your security team
3) Priyom will scope the pilot lead time and resource needs

Can you confirm: which internal stakeholder should we include on the procurement lane (email for procurement contact)? Also, are there any mandatory procurement windows (e.g., month-end reviews) we should be aware of?

Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-23T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: NovaHealth / Redwood Inference - MAP draft & timeline update

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear MAP. A few notes after internal sync:  

- Procurement is looped (procurement@novahealth.com). They do a formal review the week of 12/13, so the 12/15 target close looks tight.
- Security wants to run the SOC2 evidence through their intake; they may request an additional week for the review. Our security reviewer is Mark Hsu (mark.hsu@novahealth.com).
- Clinical ops flagged that pilot data availability will slip by ~2 weeks (ETL work delayed).

Given all that, we need to reforecast the target close to the week of 12/27 — are you able to support a revised plan with reprioritized milestones (i.e., move pilot setup later, keep procurement prep earlier)?

Also — can Rishi share the SOC2 artifact summary directly with Mark (cc'd?) so we can keep the security review moving?

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product Partnerships | NovaHealth
jordan.smith@novahealth.com | (617) 555-0198

- Redwood to deliver final pricing appendix + SOW by 12/03 (Marissa)
